messages:
incident-bot: Alert: elevated 5xx + timeout spike detected for gateway-proxy (us-east-1). 5m error rate 7.8% (baseline ~0.3%). Auto-paging oncall.

dana_liu: ack — jumping in. Can folks pause new deploys? I'll grab logs and correlation.

priya_menon: looking at runtime metrics — large surge in KV/prefix-cache miss latency and backend DB read latency. Prefetcher error rate up after the 02:12 rollout. Commit: abc1234ef.

ben_carter: any 502 vs 504 breakdown? also check kv eviction rate.

priya_menon: quick numbers: 502s ~55%, 504s/timeouts ~35%, other 5xx ~10%. Cache eviction rate spiked ~x12 on prefix-shards 3-5. Link: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/d/kv-prefetch?orgId=1&from=now-30m

marco_reyes: CS: getting a handful of high-traffic customers complaining about timeouts on search/generate. Working with them, will DM affected tenant ids.

dana_liu: hypothesis — prefetcher triggered eviction storm -> backend thundering reads -> gateway timeouts. Priority: mitigate customer impact now, then stabilize cache.

ben_carter: mitigation options: 1) disable prefetch/async-warm feature flag, 2) route critical tenants to bypass-prefix-cache header, 3) scale prefix-cache pods and restart affected shards, 4) add short-term read-through backoff.

priya_menon: agree. I'm going to flip the prefetch flag to OFF for us-east-1, then scale shard pool + restart prefix-cache on shards 3-5. Will also enable DB read rate limiting for cache miss storms.

deploy-bot: runbook step executed: set feature_flag("prefix_prefetch", false) in us-east-1 — ok (rollout id: ff-roll-20260315-01).

dana_liu: executing bypass for critical tenants now. Marco, which tenant ids?

marco_reyes: DMed list of 3 tenant ids (T-314, T-772, T-991) — they were seeing the worst tail latencies.

priya_menon: scaling prefix-cache pool from 8 -> 16 replicas in us-east-1, restarting shards 3,4,5 sequentially to avoid simultaneous eviction. Command:

```
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/prefix-cache-shard-3
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/prefix-cache-shard-4
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/prefix-cache-shard-5
```

ben_carter: also setting temporary routing rule to prefer deduped KV fallback (less memory pressure). Adding header-based bypass for critical tenants:

```
proxy rule: if X-Bypass-Prefix-Cache == true -> route to read-through pool
```

dana_liu: being done. Patch applied to edge-proxy config and reloaded.

deploy-bot: proxy reload ok (config hash b4f2e). No error on restart.

priya_menon: rolling restarts in progress. Watching eviction metrics.

(3m later)

priya_menon: eviction spike dropping, miss latency starting to fall. Gateway 5m error rate down to ~1.9%.

ben_carter: good. Can we confirm customer impact reduction? Marco?

marco_reyes: CS reports two tenants recovered in last 6m; T-991 still saw 1 timeout but overall requests succeeded. I'm sending customer note and offering a post-incident follow-up.

dana_liu: switching to monitoring mode. I'll keep this thread open for handoff. Next steps: triage root cause in postmortem (likely prefetch eviction policy + memory accounting bug), reproduce locally, and add safety circuit to abort prefetch when eviction pressure exceeds threshold.

priya_menon: capturing logs for shards 3-5, snapshotting heap and eviction traces. Filing internal issue with suggested patch (disable aggressive prefetch when global_eviction_rate > 5/s). Also adding integration test for prefetch backpressure.

ben_carter: I'll own the on-call handoff. @oncall-handoff-bot can you create a follow-up ticket and assign to eng-runtime + eng-sre with P0 -> P1 transition after 2h observation?

oncall-handoff-bot: Created INC-20260315-0457: "KV prefix prefetch eviction storm -> gateway 5xx". Assigned: eng-runtime (priya_menon), eng-sre (ben_carter). Severity: P1. Due: 2026-03-15T18:30:00Z.

priya_menon: error rate now stable at 0.5% over 5m window. Keeping prefetch OFF until we patch and validate.

dana_liu: handoff to Ben for the 4hr follow-up. Ben, you have the pager.

ben_carter: taking handoff. I'll monitor for next 120m, validate reproductions, and coordinate postmortem. If anything trends up, I'll re-escalate.

marco_reyes: customer comms sent to affected tenants. Will schedule follow-up call for impacted customers tomorrow.

dana_liu: closing active mitigation loop. Post-incident checklist: 1) run fio on prefix shards to validate eviction thresholds, 2) land prefetch backpressure fix + tests, 3) add alert for sustained eviction-rate > 3/s, 4) include customer impact summary in postmortem.

priya_menon: adding runbook doc link and candidate patch in INC ticket.

ben_carter: thanks everyone. Recording timeline and artifacts in the incident ticket. Will publish postmortem within 48h.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Current 5m error rate 0.4%. If stable for 60m, change state to resolved.

(Resolved note to be appended if no regressions)
